title: Pool Maintenance Log
subtitle: Facility Pool Maintenance: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Pool Maintenance Log covers pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area. The aquatics facility coordinator records Facility Pool Maintenance events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Pool Maintenance Log keeps Facility Pool Maintenance exceptions visible until the aquatics facility coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Pool Maintenance Log at pool vessel, equipment room, chemical storage, deck, and user-access point. Document pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area identity before Facility Pool Maintenance begins. Compare pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area findings with stated Facility Pool Maintenance criteria; route unresolved Facility Pool Maintenance issues to qualified pool-operations reviewer. For Pool Maintenance Log, confirm requirements for Facility Pool Maintenance. Ask qualified pool-operations reviewer to review Facility Pool Maintenance conditions beyond the aquatics facility coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking period and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Facility Pool Maintenance, identify responsible parties, pool vessel, equipment room, chemical storage, deck, and user-access point, and the linked pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area source.

fields.label: Operating target, prior reading, and service interval

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Facility Pool Maintenance facts for pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Facility Pool Maintenance tracked controls
items: Disinfectant, pH, temperature, and clarity reading
Circulation, filter pressure, flow, and leak condition
Chemical feed, container, labeling, and storage condition
Drain cover, barrier, gate, sign, and rescue-equipment observation
Deck, handrail, ladder, lighting, and trip condition
Controller alarm, dosing response, and retest result

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: For Facility Pool Maintenance, preserve each open variance with its current state, accountable owner, and next dated update. Aquatics Facility Coordinator performs period review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Water quality or clarity outside operating criteria
Chemical leak, incompatible storage, or uncontrolled feed
Required closure or qualified review not implemented
Closure, correction, reopening, and notification record
blocks.guidance: Pause Facility Pool Maintenance when water quality, chemical control, circulation, visibility, or user-protection concern remains. Retain the available Facility Pool Maintenance proof and route unresolved pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area scope to aquatics facility coordinator.
